name: local-ai-knowledge
description: A local-first desktop knowledge workspace with explicit model API calls. RAG integration is planned.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --base ./ && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/copy-pdf-resources.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/test-unit.cjs && node tests/desktop.cjs && node tests/model-desktop.cjs && node tests/documents-desktop.cjs && node tests/chunks-desktop.cjs && node tests/chunk-search-desktop.cjs
scripts.test:chunks: npm run build && node --test tests/chunking.test.cjs && node tests/chunks-desktop.cjs
